order: Fix every finding from the prior review round without exception. Replace the copied-over runner semantics in the research seat's brief with the tool's real behavior. That behavior means a live working tree, no sandbox pinning, and no automatic retries. Each order gets just one call, with unavailability escalated to the coordinating role. Reconcile the write-capable runner with the read-only plan across three briefs. Every order carries that same restriction in its own order text. It also must pass the forbid parameter, described as a brief-level prohibition instruction rather than a sandboxed block. Rewrite the earlier incident narrative into its evidence-supported account instead. Withdraw the unsupported claim entirely rather than merely softening it. Correct two exercise reports whose dispatch-time details were dropped or wrong. Clear the minor findings too, including stale status rows and a wrong tool count. Also fix an unjustified omission, an unexplained repeated log line, and a misattributed casting rule.
claims: We resolved all four major findings and every follow-on minor issue. That work spans exactly ten files, adding 169 lines and removing 46. It covers the runner-semantics rewrite and the read-only reconciliation across three briefs. It also covers the incident-narrative rewrite and two corrected exercise reports. The tool count was fixed to the actual four registered tools. We confirmed that count by checking each brief against the tool registry. Each change was verified line by line against the source file it corrects.
